rewards: Access to the Hot Air Balloon transport system.

st.t: Bank all weapons and armour you have, and go to Port Sarim to get a boat to Entrana.
Talk to Auguste on Entrana, just north of the Herblore shop, 3 times.
Use papyrus on a ball of wool.
Use a candle on the balloon.
Talk to Auguste with 2 papyrus and a sack of potatoes.
Talk to Auguste after the flash mob.
Fill your empty sacks on the sand pit south of Auguste.
Give Auguste the sandbags, silk, dyes, and bowl.
s: Yes, I want to give you some items.

st.t: Get 12 willow branches and use them on the platform next to Auguste to make the basket.

Talk to Auguste to fly. The next step lists every button to press. If you crash, you need 10 more logs and a tinderbox, then talk to Auguste on Entrana to try again. You don't have to rebuild the balloon.

Navigate the balloon with these buttons. Screen 1: drop a sandbag, burn a log, relax 9 times, pull the red rope, relax 2 times, pull the brown rope, relax 5 times. Screen 2: burn a log, relax, burn a log, relax 10 times, burn a log, relax 5 times. Screen 3: relax 7 times, pull the red rope, pull the brown rope, relax 3 times, burn a log, relax 4 times, pull the brown rope.
Talk to Auguste in Taverley to finish the quest.
